title: Instagram rolls out AI that spots teens using adult birthdays

slides.text: The birthday you typed years ago may not be the one that counts anymore. Now the app is making its own guess.

caption:
The birthday you typed into Instagram may no longer be the last word on how old you are.

Meta announced on Monday, November 9, 2026 that Instagram is rolling out AI that estimates whether a user is a teenager, even if the account lists an adult birthday. "We use AI technology to find people we suspect to be teens, even if they use an adult birthday," the company said.

Accounts the AI suspects belong to teens are moved into Teen Account settings, the more restricted version of the app. Meta tested the approach in the US, UK, Canada and Australia first. Earlier coverage of the tool said it looks at signals such as who an account follows and what content it engages with, and that adults flagged by mistake can change their settings back.

The rollout begins this month on Instagram, with Facebook and Threads planned later in the year. In the US, parents who set up Instagram for their teens will be notified.

The timing is not an accident. US state attorneys general are suing Meta, alleging its platforms fail to verify ages and expose minors to harm, and Meta has urged TikTok and YouTube to adopt similar measures.

Would you want an app guessing your age from how you use it?

Source: Al Jazeera; Android Central
